sentences.en: Pitbulls and Parolees is an Animal Planet reality TV show that highlights the relationship between pitbulls and ex-cons.
sentences.vi: Pitbulls and Parolees là một chương trình truyền hình thực tế về Animal Planet đề cập đến mối quan hệ giữa pitbull và người yêu cũ.

sentences.en: The relationship between the pitbulls and the parolees is unique as it allows both the animal and the parolee a chance at redemption.

sentences.en: One of the positive things about Pitbulls and Parolees is that, much like Conviction Kitchen, it gives parolees a new chance at life.

sentences.en: Many of the parolees at the center enjoy seeing this second chance for the misunderstood dogs, as they themselves work towards a brighter future.
